spans: This Walabot-HOME Reseller Agreement ("Agreement") is made and entered into as of this 31 day of July 2019 ("Effective Date")

General Supplier and/or Reseller may assign or novate this Agreement and the rights and obligations under it to any of its affiliates or upon any merger or acquisition or the sale of all or substantially all of its assets relating to the Agreement. Any purported assignment of rights in violation of this subsection is void.
This Agreement shall become effective on the Effective Date and shall remain in effect for an initial period of 1 year ("Initial Term").
This Walabot-HOME Reseller Agreement ("Agreement") is made and entered into as of this 31 day of July 2019 ("Effective Date")

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York and all disputes and controversies arising out of or in connection with the Agreement shall be brought exclusively before the competent courts in New York County, New York

Supplier hereby grants Reseller a non-transferable, revocable, limited right to resell, market, promote, stimulate interest in, and solicit Orders by Customers and/or End Users in the Territory for the Products and to provide services in connection with those activities.

Vayyar Imaging Ltd., having its principal place of business at 3 Avraham Giron St., POB. 325, Yehud 5621717, Israel ("Supplier"), and Inde Living Holdings, Inc., having its principal place of business at 1462 Rudder Lane, Knoxville, TN 37919 ("Reseller").
Parties.answer: Vayyar Imaging Ltd. ("Supplier"); Inde Living Holdings, Inc. ("Reseller")

notes: License Grant is a borderline Yes — the Section 2 grant is a limited right to resell, market and promote rather than a technology licence, but it is an express grant of rights in the Products to the counterparty. IP Ownership Assignment is No because clause 7.1 is Supplier retaining its own IP (with Reseller expressly keeping rights in its permitted modifications), and Anti-Assignment is Yes since assignments outside the affiliate/merger/asset-sale carve-outs are void.
